title: Tractable Predictive Representations of Human Hippocampal Spiking
scientific_scope: Comparative causal predictive representations, not physical hippocampal implementation or neural primitives

development.partitions: use old train for fitting and old validation for predefined selection; old test forbidden for all v2 executions
development.subjects: subject-session labels and splits inherited read-only from v1 manifests, never re-shuffle

companion.reason: same patients/task, different modality; never substitute iEEG for spike prediction

external.role: independent convergent locked validation candidate, metadata audit required
external.task: recognition memory, not the primary verbal working-memory task
external.split: chronological whole valid recognition trials60% calibration training/40% final, floor60%, no external validation used for tuning
external.policy: development-selected hyperparameter/family candidates frozen before any external spike access; target session-local emissions/model parameters fitted on calibration train only under frozen policy; final-score one-shot after all masks/parameters/seeds frozen
external.independence_boundary: source-cohort/site-disjoint evidence; private cross-border patient reidentification unavailable and never inferred from unrelated pseudonyms

allowed: pinned API release and asset metadata
NWB unit ids/electrode references/location and trial start/stop/phase metadata only
forbidden: any final prediction or outcome scores

eligibility.anatomy: explicit hippocampus; keep hemisphere; other MTL and unknown excluded
eligibility.unit_selection: training-only finite timestamps and observation coverage, published anatomy; no external final-rate/quality filtering
eligibility.independent_unit: patient, group sessions/units under canonical patient id; repeated subject aliases require mapping or exclusion before spikes
eligibility.r0_minimum: at least8 independent external metadata candidate patients each with >=5 explicit hippocampal unit labels and >=40 valid recognition trials; training spike adequacy separately R2

features.common_covariates: causal log1p spike history, within-trial elapsed-time basis, trial position, task/block and stimulus attributes known at scored time; never response time, confidence, correctness or future event timing

models.common: matched train-fitted combined causal GLM log-intensity offset, same count masks/covariates/exposure; report shared plus extra parameters

discrete.family: Poisson HMM exact log-space forward filter
discrete.emission: common offset plus state-specific unit biases

continuous.recursion: h_t=tanh(A*h_(t-1)+B*log1p(y_(t-1))+D*x_t); lambda_t=exp(common_offset_t+C*h_t); h_t deterministic given past, never a sampled PLDS latent
continuous.likelihood: exact conditional product-Poisson score, no integration/ELBO/plugin latent replacement

hybrid.emission: common offset plus state-specific biases and state-specific causal observed-own-history coefficients
hybrid.likelihood: exact forward marginal over discrete states conditional on observed history, no continuous latent integration

models.training: max500 iterations, normalized penalized objective, tolerance1e-5; retain every seed and numerical/convergence diagnostics; deterministic fallback is not allowed to silently remove a required family
models.numerical_gate: analytic Poisson, exact exhaustive small-state forward, causal future-perturbation and analytic-gradient checks; finite log-space scores and difference<=1e-10 nats/unit-bin for tractable oracle tests; no v1 gate reclassification
models.selection: each initialization retained, best training objective within fixed candidate; development-only one-SE whole-trial selection, prefer fewer total free parameters; report validation frontier and overlapping parameter-budget comparisons, no external/final selection
models.nonconvergence: required family/candidate failure stops, never select only successful seeds or relabel family losing

metric.name: joint causal one-step spike-count predictive log likelihood
metric.normalization: sum log p(y_t | y_<t, causal context)/observed unit-bin count
metric.aggregation: equal-session means within patient then equal-patient means
metric.external_model_identity: family/hyperparameter transfer with calibration-training-only fitting of new session-local parameters; no persistent neuron identity or zero-shot claim

statistics.sign_flip: exact enumeration for<=20 subjects, otherwise100000 fixed seed20261011; symmetry/exchangeability caveat
statistics.multiplicity: Holm six contrasts:3 family-pairs and3 vs strongest baseline, separately in dev and external
statistics.interpretation: development is exposed exploratory; external is independent convergent test, task difference disclosed; prediction ranking not physical ontology

controls: task/event timing shifts preserving trial/unit totals
nulls.pipeline: refit development-selected fixed hyperparameter candidates and strongest baseline on controlled calibration/train data, score matching transformed development or external partitions; no retuning grids; full controls partition-local, never borrow heldout data
nulls.external_unlock: control rule and selected configurations frozen before any external spikes, perform one final assessment only; preserve all null outcomes
nulls.trial_position_control: drift-aware combined baseline included in every contrast
nulls.hypothesis: predictive advantage over firing-rate/event-timing structure, not microscopic mechanism

gates.R0: prospective lock, honest exposure audit, independent frozen external metadata candidate manifest and adequacy, code/tests/QC/reproduction
gates.R1: all model families implemented and oracle-tested, no external spikes
gates.R2: development fits, statistical/null outputs, frozen selection and independently locked external validation; stop numeric/cohort/independence failure
gates.R3: full package A1-A10 and verified reproduction, only after preceding valid gates

amendments: separate append-only version before affected outcome access; previously inspected final data cannot become pristine again
